nature_language: 当前位置上海。我一个人想去南京玩2天，坐火车，预算2500人民币，喜欢历史古迹的景点，住一间有桑拿的酒店，每顿饭不超过70元，请给我一个旅行规划。
nature_language_en: Current location: Shanghai. I want to travel alone to Nanjing for 2 days by train, with a budget of 2500 RMB. I am interested in historical sites and would like to stay in a hotel with a sauna. I plan to spend no more than 70 RMB per meal. Please provide me with a travel itinerary.
